annotations.title: Carry out an approved Live action

description: Checks the approval request_live_action started; once the founder approved it, carries the action out — once — and answers what happened. Waiting: a repeat call a few seconds later checks again. Denied or expired: nothing changed. Refused when carried out (the plan isn't paid, the name moved, a rate limit): nothing changed and the approval isn't used up — the answer says why and gives a new handle for a retry once the cause is fixed.
name: live_action_status
title: Carry out an approved Live action
